gold: Masquerading bundle-branch block (MBBB) with progression to advanced atrioventricular block

selector.rationale: ECG findings of prolonged PR interval, prolonged QRS duration, and notched and monophasic R-wave in V1 support Left Bundle Branch Block, which best explains the decisive ECG findings without contradiction.

rejected.label: Prosthetic Valve Thrombosis
rejected.why: No direct evidence of valve dysfunction or thrombosis in current presentation

rejected.label: Left ventricular dysfunction
rejected.why: While present, it is a broader condition and less specific than Left Bundle Branch Block

rejected.label: High-degree atrioventricular (AV) block
rejected.why: Prolonged PR interval but no evidence of higher degree AV block
